comment: One production branch per part (docs/plans/production-branches.md). `paths` are relative to `base` (default 'Full CRM Turf'); a branch holds only those, at those paths, plus .gitignore. `rust: true` adds the Cargo workspace file, cut down to the members present, and Cargo.lock.

components.name: landing-web-production
components.title: Landing site: frontend
components.build: npm install && npm run build   (static files in dist/)

components.name: landing-backend-production
components.title: Landing site: backend
components.build: npm start   (Node 24+, no dependencies)

components.name: auth-backend-production
components.title: Authentication service
components.build: docker build -f services/auth/Dockerfile -t turf-auth .   or   cargo test -p turf-auth -p turf-auth-verify

components.name: notifications-backend-production
components.title: Notification service
components.build: go test ./... in services/notifications; docker build -f Dockerfile services/notifications

components.name: billing-backend-production
components.title: Billing service
components.build: npm test in services/billing; docker build services/billing

components.name: gateway-backend-production
components.title: Gateway
components.build: go test ./... in services/gateway; docker build services/gateway

components.name: core-api-backend-production
components.title: Core API (the CRM server, and the website it serves)
components.build: cd services/core-api/rust && cargo test --workspace   (needs PostgreSQL: services/core-api/README.md)

components.name: importing-lists-backend-production
components.title: Importing lists (server)
components.build: python -m unittest discover -s tests in the service folder

components.name: skip-tracing-backend-production
components.title: Skip tracing (server)
components.build: python -m unittest discover -s tests in the service folder

components.name: dialer-sms-backend-production
components.title: Dialer, auto dialing and SMS
components.build: npm test in the service folder

components.name: leads-map-backend-production
components.title: Leads map (server)
components.build: cargo test -p turf-leads-map

components.name: crm-backend-production
components.title: The CRM service
components.build: cargo test -p turf-crm

components.name: ai-campaigns-backend-production
components.title: AI campaigns
components.build: npm test in the service folder

components.name: exports-backend-production
components.title: Exports (server)
components.build: python -m unittest discover -s tests in the service folder

components.name: backup-restore-backend-production
components.title: Backup and restore (server)
components.build: cargo test -p turf-backup-restore

components.name: desktop-frontend-production
components.title: Desktop app and CRM: frontend
components.build: npm install && npm run build, then TURF_SERVICE_ROOT=<a skip-engine-production checkout> npm test   (its tests run the Python engine)

components.name: desktop-container-production
components.title: Desktop app: window container (Tauri), with the frontend it packs
components.build: npm install && npm run build in desktop/frontend/react, then cargo build in desktop/container/rust; at run time it starts the Skip Tracing engine from skip-engine-production (TURF_SERVICE_ROOT)

components.name: desktop-backend-production
components.title: Desktop app: feature modules
components.build: cargo test --workspace

components.name: deploy-production
components.title: Deployment: every service on one machine
components.build: docker compose --env-file env/compose.env -f deploy/compose.yml up --build   (from a checkout of all the parts)

components.name: turf-app-production
components.title: Turf app (the original desktop app)
components.build: npm install && npm run build

components.name: skip-engine-production
components.title: Skip Tracing engine (Python)
components.build: pip install -r requirements.txt pytest && python -m pytest
